text: Chemistry is a fundamental natural science (professional code: 070301) that focuses on the composition, structure, properties and change laws of substances. It belongs to the category of science, with a four-year duration of study and confers a Bachelor of Science degree. As a "central science", chemistry connects multiple disciplines such as physics, biology, materials science, and environment. It not only studies the microscopic mechanisms at the atomic and molecular levels but also explores practical applications such as new material synthesis, energy conversion, and drug development. It is one of the key disciplines driving the development of modern science and technology.
